info.name: Smart_Agriculture_API
info.description: Phases 1-8 REST API for smart agricultural advisory, marketplace transactions, and model-backed disease screening. The disease model and label map must be supplied. Daraja callbacks are provider-originated; mock payment callbacks are development/test simulations only.

request.description: No authentication. HTTP 200 means the API process responds.

response.name: 200 OK
response.body: {"status":"ok","service":"Smart Agriculture Advisory and Market Linkage API"}

request.description: No authentication. Returns 200 when MongoDB responds to ping or 503 when it is unavailable.

exec: pm.test('MongoDB readiness status is explicit', () => pm.expect([200, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Public registration. Rerunning returns 409 for an already registered email or phone.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const u=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('FARMER'); pm.expect(u).not.to.have.property('password_hash'); pm.environment.set('farmer_id', u.id); }
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const u=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('BUYER'); pm.environment.set('buyer_id', u.id); }

request.description: One-time setup. Set admin_bootstrap_token in the selected Postman environment from your private .env. Never publish that value.

exec: pm.test('Created once or correctly reports existing admin', () => pm.expect([201,409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Login the agricultural officer account created by the admin request.

item.name: Buyer forbidden from admin user list (negative test)

request.description: First run Login buyer, then send this test after preserving buyer_access_token as described in README; the normal login request uses access_token for convenience.

item.name: Public registration rejects role injection (negative test)

exec: pm.test('Extra role field is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));

request.description: Login buyer first so access_token contains the buyer JWT.
Farmer owner only. Returns 204 and deactivates this farm; run after any crop testing that depends on it.
Farmer owner only. Returns 204 and deactivates this crop.

item.name: Buyer cannot create a listing (negative test)

request.description: Login buyer first to use the buyer token.
Run after completing orders that use this listing.
Run after logging in as the farmer/seller.

item.name: Seller cannot set PAID status (negative test)

request.description: Use farmer token. PAID status is set only by verified payment callbacks in Phase 5.

item.name: Cancel unpaid order and release stock

request.description: Buyer only. Safe to retry: inventory release is idempotent.
Requires the buyer token and an AWAITING_PAYMENT order. The Idempotency-Key prevents a retry from creating another charge. STK Push acceptance is not payment confirmation.
Use only when PAYMENT_PROVIDER=mock and APP_ENV is development/test. This labels an internal payment simulation; it is not an M-PESA transaction.
Repeat the exact mock callback; it must not duplicate ledger entries.
Run before confirming the successful mock callback, or create a fresh order/payment.
Use a separate unpaid order/payment. This records a mock failure and does not mark its order paid.
Queries Daraja STKPushQuery when configured. Does not mutate local payment or order status.

item.name: Payment hidden from another buyer (negative test)

request.description: Public webhook called by Safaricom. Do not send fabricated success callbacks from Postman. An empty example will be rejected or remain unverifiable; successful payment requires a real provider callback plus a verified status query.

item.name: Seller release is blocked until delivery completion

request.description: Expected in Phase 5: no delivery-confirmation workflow exists until Phase 6. Unresolved disputes also block release.
Buyer-only. Mock mode records a refund request but never transfers money.
Seller-only. Order must be READY_FOR_DELIVERY.
Seller progress update.
Seller progress update.
Seller records delivery; this does not complete the order until buyer confirmation.
Buyer-only; completes the order after seller marks it delivered.
Buyer or farmer; returns only the current user’s deliveries.
Buyer, seller, or admin; other users receive 404.
Open only one dispute for a paid order; do this before buyer confirmation if the order is ready for delivery.
Participant-only dispute list.
Only a dispute participant or admin can read this dispute.
Agricultural officer/admin only. Fill observed_price_kes and price_date with a real measured observation and cite its source; no market values are bundled as facts.
Authenticated farmer, buyer, admin or officer can read recorded observations.
Returns the latest recorded observation for each market/location and unit. Empty items means there is no recorded data.
Returns dated observations, preserving previous values.
Adds a new record linked with supersedes_id; it does not erase the original. Supply the corrected, verified amount and date.
Uses OpenWeatherMap current conditions and 5 day / 3 hour forecast. Requires WEATHER_API_KEY on the backend. Missing key/provider outage returns 503; no synthetic weather is returned.
Agricultural officer/admin authored guidance; set crop_name and county to target it, or leave them null to make it general.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "County planting information",
  "message": "Contact your county agricultural extension officer for current, location-specific planting dates and crop guidance.",
  "crop_name": "Maize",
  "county": "Nakuru",
  "source_name": "{{advisory_source_name}}"
}

request.description: Shows active officer advisories matching the crop/county and the current farmer weather recommendation history.
Requires owned farm and crop IDs plus WEATHER_API_KEY. Creates history tied to that farm/crop. Heuristics are prompts to check soil/weather, not guaranteed agronomic advice.
Farmer-only history of generated weather prompts.
Only the authoring officer or admin may manage this record.

Farmer-only. Select a JPEG, PNG, or WebP file for form field image. HTTP 201 returns a model prediction and stores metadata/history; HTTP 503 is expected until trained model and label files are configured. Never treat the score as a guaranteed diagnosis.

exec: pm.test('Prediction either returned or model is honestly unavailable',()=>pm.expect([201,503]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Farmer-only; shows only the authenticated farmer’s prediction metadata.

Public read-only educational catalogue. Returns 11 records that correspond to model labels. No pesticide recommendations are provided. Source checked does not mean a county extension officer reviewed a specific farm.

exec: pm.test('all guidance records include a source and no chemical recommendation', () => body.items.forEach(item => { pm.expect(item.sources.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(item.chemical_guidance_available).to.eql(false); }));

request.description: Public. Filter by exact supported crop name: Maize, Potato, or Tomato.

exec: pm.test('all returned entries match Tomato', () => pm.response.json().items.forEach(item => pm.expect(item.crop_name).to.eql('Tomato')));

item.name: Get guidance for a model label

request.description: Public. Copy predicted_label from a screening response into the disease_label environment variable. URL-encode spaces if your Postman version does not encode substituted variables.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200 for a supported class', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('response has display name and traceable source', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.display_name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.sources.length).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: FARMER only. Requires a unique Idempotency-Key header (add it manually). Chemical history requires an approved PCPB evidence record matched to the predicted crop and disease. This endpoint records an action; it does not recommend treatment.

FARMER only. Select a new JPEG/PNG/WebP image. Add Idempotency-Key as a header. Runs the configured model; 503 is expected when model assets are unavailable. The original file is not persisted; only image hash and metadata are recorded. Same/different predicted labels do not prove improvement or worsening.
FARMER owner only. Returns original screening, follow-up screenings, and farmer-entered activity history.
FARMER owner only. Changes case status to REVIEW_REQUESTED; repeated requests return 409. A request does not guarantee officer availability.
AGRICULTURAL_OFFICER or ADMIN. Lists cases for which farmers requested review.
AGRICULTURAL_OFFICER or ADMIN. Response is appended to report review history; only REVIEW_REQUESTED cases are accepted.
FARMER owner only. Records the farmer-reported status. It does not verify that the crop is disease-free; resolved cases cannot be reopened through this endpoint.

Admin/officer operation to a registered account. EVENT can be REGISTRATION, NEW_ORDER, PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION, DELIVERY_UPDATE, DISPUTE_UPDATE, SELLER_PAYOUT, or AGRICULTURAL_ADVISORY. Africa's Talking Sandbox returns SIMULATED and records the message in its simulator; no handset receives it. Production provider acceptance does not confirm handset delivery. Never place API keys in Postman requests.
Returns only notifications addressed to this authenticated user.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Administrator-only account, payment, and dispute operations. Bootstrap token and admin bearer token must remain private.

request.description: Admin-only.
Admin-only. Every review action is appended to the dispute decision audit trail.
Admin-only. REFUND_BUYER is a decision record; it does not itself move funds. Use the escrow refund request and a configured provider for an actual refund.
Participant or admin.
Requires buyer delivery confirmation and no unresolved disputes. In development, mock mode records SIMULATED_SETTLEMENT only; it never transfers funds. A real provider must confirm payout.

item.name: Submit PCPB evidence draft (replace with verified source data)

body.raw:
{
  "registration_number": "REPLACE_WITH_PCPB_REGISTRATION_NUMBER",
  "trade_name": "REPLACE_WITH_EXACT_PCPB_TRADE_NAME",
  "formulation": "REPLACE_WITH_PCPB_FORMULATION",
  "active_ingredients": [
    "REPLACE_WITH_PCPB_ACTIVE_INGREDIENTS"
  ],
  "registered_uses": [
    "REPLACE_WITH_EXACT_CROP_AND_USE_FROM_APPROVED_LABEL"
  ],
  "pcpb_record_url": "https://www.pcpb.go.ke/crops/",
  "approved_label_url": "https://www.pcpb.go.ke/crops/",
  "source_checked_on": "2026-11-22",
  "source_reference": "Replace with current PCPB record and approved label reference"
}

request.description: ADMIN or AGRICULTURAL_OFFICER. Do not send this placeholder body as a real product record. Replace every placeholder only after checking the current PCPB crop registration and linked approved label. This request creates a PENDING_REVIEW record; it does not authorize or recommend use.

exec: pm.test('draft was created as pending review', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.review_status).to.eql('PENDING_REVIEW'); pm.environment.set('pesticide_record_id', body.id); });

request.description: ADMIN or AGRICULTURAL_OFFICER. Review both the live PCPB record and the linked approved label outside the app before any admin approval.

exec: pm.test('list response has pagination', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.total).to.be.a('number'); });

item.name: Approve pesticide evidence (admin only, after PCPB review)

request.description: ADMIN only. Send only after personally verifying the current registration and approved label. Approval makes the verified record visible in the farmer listing; it does not prescribe a dose or override the full label.

exec: pm.test('review decision recorded', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.review_status).to.eql('APPROVED'); pm.expect(body.review_events.length).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: FARMER. Returns records that passed the administrator evidence-review workflow. It is a product reference list, not an automated treatment recommendation.
FARMER owner only. Stage order and sources for supported crops. Does not produce county planting dates or fixed day intervals.
FARMER only. Optional soil_test_date and soil_test_reference can be supplied. Creates a farm-linked education advisory; no fertilizer rate or product is generated.
Public read-only educational catalogue. Includes only source-backed entries; the disease model does not identify pests.
Public, non-chemical, source-linked pest education. This is not an image identification endpoint.
Public. Returns entries for the requested crop where reviewed guidance exists.
Public source-backed educational detail. Use a slug from the list response, such as fall-armyworm or tomato-whitefly.
